import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Codeforces
{
    public static void main(String args[])throws Exception
    {
        BufferedReader bu=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringBuilder sb=new StringBuilder();
        String s[]=bu.readLine().split(" ");
        int n=Integer.parseInt(s[0]),b=Integer.parseInt(s[1]);
        int i,x=0,a[]=new int[n],l[]=new int[n];
        s=bu.readLine().split(" ");
        for(i=0;i<n;i++)
        {
            a[i]=Integer.parseInt(s[i]);
            if(a[i]%2==0) x++;
            else x--;
            l[i]=x;
        }
        ArrayList<Integer> al=new ArrayList<>();
        for(i=0;i<n-1;i++)
        if(l[i]==0) al.add(Math.abs(a[i]-a[i+1]));
        Collections.sort(al);

        int cuts=0,cr=0;
        for(i=0;i<al.size();i++)
        {
            if(cr+al.get(i)<=b) {cr+=al.get(i); cuts++;}
            if(cr>=b) break;
        }
        System.out.print(cuts);
    }
}
